name: Staying Strong
overview: Scripture calls believers to remain strong and courageous, not fearing adversity, because the LORD is always with them and will never forsake them, as seen in Deuteronomy 31:6 and Joshua 1:9. Strength comes not from human effort alone but is a divine gift, with God empowering the weak and renewing the strength of those who wait upon Him, according to Isaiah 40:29 and 40:31. God's presence brings help and upholdment in times of difficulty, assuring believers that they can face tribulation with peace and confidence, knowing Christ has overcome the world, as expressed in Isaiah 41:10 and John 16:33.
